prompts.terrain: Use case stylized-concept. Production pixel art game assets matching supplied Adam hero reference style only: crisp dark outlines, saturated readable colours, pixel clusters, cartoon adventure aesthetic. Transparent RGBA background, no text labels borders guide lines or checkerboard, no shadows outside sprites. No magic sorcery occult or related themes. Do not include characters. Terrain texture tile source atlas EXACT4 columns by4 rows,16 square tiles, each square axis-aligned/front-on, NO isometric perspective. Uniform192px square logical source cell on1024x1024 canvas, ample transparent gap around each opaque square so tiles are individually extractable. All squares same size and fully filled to square edges, no bevel or border. Row1 four grass-over-brown-dirt side-view ground tiles, lush grass at top then solid soil extending to bottom, matching neighbour edge heights, four interior pebble variations. Row2 four brown soil fill tiles for underground, four interior pebble variations. Row3 four grey stone block fill tiles, four interior pattern variations. Row4 sand fill tile, wooden planks fill tile, dark-blue calm water fill tile, shallow blue water fill tile. Grass tiles top edge level. No decorative plants outside square. These will be converted to exact64x64 textures with compatible repeat edges.
prompts.props: Use case stylized-concept. Production pixel art scenery matching Adam's crisp dark outlines, cartoon shading and saturated palette. Transparent RGBA background, no text, guides, borders, shadows, characters, magic or occult. EXACT4 columns by3 rows with clean gaps (12 separate sprites). Each object drawn fully visible FRONT SIDE VIEW, feet/base consistently at bottom of cell. Row1: narrow leafy tree with trunk tall slender silhouette; broad oak tree width roughly same as height; narrow tall pine tree; broad fruit tree with red apples. prompts.ui_panels: Use case stylized-concept. Production pixel-art UI source sprites for cartoon adventure game matching Adam reference crisp dark outlines and pixel shading. TRUE transparent RGBA background. EXACT4columns by3rows,12 separate UI widgets with ample gaps. No text letters numbers labels guides borders around the sheet characters magic occult or symbols. Row1 FOUR wide rectangular blank beveled buttons in order normal blue/gold trim, hover lighter blue/gold trim, pressed darker blue/gold trim inset, disabled desaturated grey. All four EXACT same silhouette rectangular ratio4:1, straight edges and simple corners, no symbols. Row2 FOUR panels: blank light parchment dialogue rectangle with subtle rolled corners (ratio2:1); second blank parchment dialogue with brown wooden trim ratio2:1; blue/gold inventory panel rectangle ratio1:1; dark blue/gold tooltip panel rectangle ratio2:1. Blank centres evenly coloured so runtime text is legible and scalable. Row3 FOUR horizontal status bars ratio4:1: empty dark framed track, red health fill inside framed track, green stamina fill inside same framed track, yellow experience fill inside same framed track. Each bar same shape dimensions. No hearts or emblems baked into bars. Canvas1536x1152. Keep pixel style hard edges no photographic textures.
